task_completion.description: Enable the 'Recurring Revenues' feature in CRM settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the CRM Configuration/Settings page with the 'Recurring Revenues' checkbox checked and saved.

task_completion.description: Create a recurring plan named 'Quarterly' with a 3-month duration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form view or list view in CRM Configuration > Recurring Plans showing a plan named 'Quarterly' with 'Number of Months' set to 3.

task_completion.description: Create a new opportunity for 'Apex Logic' named 'Apex Logic - Enterprise Bundle'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The opportunity form view showing the 'Opportunity' field as 'Apex Logic - Enterprise Bundle' and 'Customer' as 'Apex Logic'.

task_completion.description: Set the expected one-time revenue to 2,500.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Expected Revenue' or 'Expected Revenue (One-time)' field in the opportunity form showing the value 2,500.00.
The 'Recurring Revenue' field in the opportunity form showing the value 600.00.

task_completion.description: Assign the 'Quarterly' recurring plan to the opportunity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Recurring Plan' dropdown field in the opportunity form showing 'Quarterly' selected.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database queries or scripts via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and form filling in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the values into the Odoo fields rather than just displaying a success message.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots capture the process of typing 'Quarterly', '600', and '2500' into the respective UI elements.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menu to reach settings and opportunities.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking through 'CRM' -> 'Configuration' and 'CRM' -> 'My Pipeline'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The recurring plan must be named 'Quarterly' and have exactly 3 months duration. The opportunity name is 'Apex Logic - Enterprise Bundle'. The expected one-time revenue is 2,500.00 and the recurring revenue is 600.00. These fields (Recurring Revenue and Recurring Plan) only appear in the Opportunity form after 'Recurring Revenues' is enabled in CRM Settings.
